name: Touchpad Edge
tagline: Hold keys, drag trackpad corners left and right
description: Touchpad Edge maps a held-key drag on each trackpad corner (top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right) to volume, display brightness or keyboard light. Hold any combination of Control, Option, Command, Shift and Fn (nothing ticked means always on) and drag right for up, left for down. A firmness threshold stops accidental touches. Global shortcuts (Control-Option-Command with arrow keys by default) cover everything when the trackpad is out of reach. Display and keyboard levels are droplet values with best-effort system volume; full system-wide corner capture needs an event tap outside the Droppy sandbox.
